paragraphs: An outbreak of Salmonella Bovismorbificans linked to broccoli sprouts remains under investigation, with 22 cases and 2 hospitalizations reported across 4 states [1]. Evergreen Fresh Sprouts LLC of Idaho is recalling 215 cases of broccoli sprouts due to potential Salmonella contamination [9]. A separate outbreak of E. coli O145 linked to frozen blueberries is also ongoing, with 17 cases and 6 hospitalizations in 2 states [3]. A previous Cyclospora outbreak linked to iceberg lettuce has ended, though it affected 12,883 people across 21 states with 570 hospitalizations and 2 deaths [2].

Danone USA is voluntarily recalling So Delicious Dairy Free Salted Caramel Cluster Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert pints with best-by dates on or before April 3, 2028, due to potential foreign materials such as small stones in the cashew inclusions [4][16]. Whole Foods Market of Austin, Texas is recalling Fromagerie Coop de Mean Cabricharme cheese because it contains undeclared egg lysozyme, an egg white protein [7]. People with egg allergies or sensitivities should avoid this product [7].
